title: István Bibó: The Misery of Small Eastern European States
grammar: Complex diagnostic cleft clauses in political analysis (éppen abban áll, hogy...)
goal: I can summarize István Bibó's diagnosis of political hysteria in small Eastern European states.
I can use *éppen abban áll, hogy* and *az ok nem más, mint* to name the root of a problem.
I can say what Bibó did on 4 November 1956.
